input_binding_audit.conclusion: The quality-gate PROFILE question is substantially resolved (NOMINAL, dual E0/E2 authority) with one open sub-item (exact YAML confirmation). The CANDIDATE-POOL IDENTITY question (fold-specific EXT-F1 pool vs. the single historical Flow-1 bank) is NOT uniquely resolved by the spec, E0, E2, existing configs, or code. And independent of both questions, the per-sample q table required to execute E8's own 9-step method for ANY fold-specific candidate pool, under ANY profile, does not exist in this repository. A dry-run bin-count table cannot be honestly computed under these conditions without inventing data that is not present.

question_A_candidate_table.finding: No persisted per-sample candidate table (sample_id, arm, route, q, quality-gate acceptance state, fold/source-domain identity) exists in this repository for EXT-F1, EXT-F2, or EXT-F3's own fold-specific reserve-tranche candidates. RESERVE_FINAL_CLOSURE.json and every RESERVE_TRANCHE*_CLOSURE.json contain only AGGREGATE counts (arm_route_counts, route_quotas) and quota-redistribution math -- never a per-candidate row. `runs/c_ext_q1q2_v1/EXT-F1/`, `EXT-F2/`, `EXT-F3/` contain only empty placeholder directories (verified: zero files under any of them). The ONLY real per-sample q table present locally is `reports/c_ext_q1q2_v1/e2_quality/reconstructed_q/C6_Q_RECONSTRUCTED.parquet` (3072 rows = 1024/arm), which is the single historical Flow-1/Version-C matched bank (`reports/full/c6/C6_BANK_LOCK_{arm}.json`), NOT any EXT-Q1Q2 fold-specific candidate pool.

question_B_which_frozen_artifact.candidate_1: E7-v1.1's own cumulative reserve-accepted candidates for EXT-F1 (fold-specific, source-only, LODO-consistent, the pool that actually trained EXT-F1's G-RND/G-DET/G-LLM detectors) -- but only aggregate counts are persisted for this pool, at every profile (STRICT/NOMINAL/PERMISSIVE); no per-sample record exists.
question_B_which_frozen_artifact.candidate_2: the pre-extension, non-fold-specific historical Flow-1/C6 NOMINAL bank (1024/arm, 3072 total) -- per-sample q IS available locally for this one (C6_Q_RECONSTRUCTED.parquet), and it is in fact the exact bank the real, persisted E2 trigger computation used. But this bank was built under the ORIGINAL Version-C protocol (not the three-fold LODO extension), predates EXT-F1/F2/F3 entirely, and was never used to train any fold's Track-G detector under this extension -- using it as E8's training input would decouple E8 from the very E7 comparison it is meant to quality-control for.
question_B_which_frozen_artifact.resolution: NOT UNIQUELY DETERMINED BY THE SPEC TEXT. Spec section 15's 9-step method and the 'Primary deployment: EXT-F1 x 5 seeds' line name neither artifact explicitly. Nothing in E0's freeze artifacts, E2's records, existing configs, protocol locks, or code comments states which of the two candidate pools is authoritative for E8's own construction. Candidate 2 is authoritative ONLY for the trigger decision (whether to run E8 at all) -- it is not stated anywhere to also be authoritative for E8's bank-construction input.

question_C_quality_profile.if_fold_specific_pool_is_intended: even granting NOMINAL as the profile, EXT-F1's own NOMINAL-profile aggregate accepted counts are recorded in EXT_F1_RESERVE_FINAL_CLOSURE.json's assessments array: physics {RND: 409, DET: 394, LLM: 45}, gpat {RND: 964, DET: 928, LLM: 705} -- but, per question A above, no per-sample q breakdown exists for these counts, so they cannot be binned into the 10 q-bins E8 requires.
question_C_quality_profile.resolved_component: NOMINAL, with two independent, E0-era pieces of authority: (1) src/prism_fas/evaluation/c_ext_e0_freeze.py's build_model_binding()-equivalent quality_gate block explicitly records {'rule': 'exact 8-criterion hard gate + q geometric-mean weight; NOMINAL profile', 'profile': 'NOMINAL', 'profile_source': 'reports/full/c6/C6_PROFILE_SELECTION_LOCK.json (STRICT infeasible)'} as the extension-wide frozen quality-gate binding, recorded before any target result and before the E7-v1.1 reserve amendment existed; (2) the REAL, persisted E2 q-reconstruction (C6_Q_RECONSTRUCTION_LOCK.json) that actually fired the E8 trigger used quality_profile='NOMINAL' for every arm. PERMISSIVE never appears in E0's frozen binding at all -- it is an ad hoc fallback profile that E7-v1.1's reserve mechanism additionally introduced later, specific to E7's own 512-common-quota feasibility problem. This audit does NOT infer PERMISSIVE from E7's convenience, per instruction; NOMINAL is the profile with actual frozen, pre-registered authority.
question_C_quality_profile.unresolved_component: E0 itself flags 'config_binding_status': 'NEEDS_CONFIRMATION' for exactly which quality_gate_m8*.yaml file (of three present: quality_gate_m8.yaml, _v2, _v3) produced quality_threshold_identity=8fa2648643cd526730497ae2d717e17684dda3ecea361fc84929db07ac03bb19, stating this 'must be confirmed against C6_GATE_PROFILES.json at E2 before any q value is consumed.' A repository-wide search finds this confirmation was never recorded anywhere in the persisted E2 artifacts (E2_QUALITY_ANALYSIS.json, C6_Q_RECONSTRUCTION_LOCK.json, E2_Q_RECONSTRUCTION_AUDIT.json) -- only the identity hash is repeated, never a resolution against a specific YAML file.

q_bin_definition.q_equals_1_0_rule: the spec's own bin notation writes the final bin closed on both ends, '[0.9,1.0]' (unlike the preceding nine half-open bins), so q=1.0 is explicitly included in bin 10 by the literal spec text -- it is never dropped and never double-counted, since bin 10 is the only bin whose upper bound is closed.
